nom: COSRX The Hyaluronic Acid 3 Serum with Amino Acids + Ceramide NP

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who called her skin extremely dry and never quite hydrated, report the serum feels hydrating though a couple found it made no real difference or even increased forehead dryness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive, allergic, or eczema/dermatitis-prone skin report the serum calmed redness, kept skin plump and moisturized without irritation, and one credited it with saving an eczema flare-up.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (some also noting redness or acne-proneness) report smoothed texture, reduced redness, and a better balance between oily and dry zones, aside from unrelated hormonal breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers identifying as having mature or 50-year-old skin report firmer, plumper skin and fewer visible fine lines.
segments.oily: One reviewer reports the serum is not oily, sinks in fast, and seemed to help reduce her oil production.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, report noticeable hydration, plumping, and a dewy or glowing finish, often describing skin as feeling less dry with continued use; a small minority report no improvement or new dryness on the forehead.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness-prone or sensitive skin report visibly reduced redness and calmer skin, including one who saw redness drop after using it alongside other calming products.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema, contact dermatitis, or reactive skin report the serum created a protective, calming barrier with no flare-ups; one review specifically credits it with resolving an eczema flare.
concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature skin report firmer skin and reduced appearance of fine lines with regular use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes the serum helped keep pores from clogging with dead skin, while another reports getting pimples specifically when combining this brand with other brands.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers with acne-prone or combination-acne skin report no new breakouts, though one reviewer reports developing pimples when layering it with other brands' products.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oil-prone areas reports the serum is not oily and appears to have reduced oil production, while another reviewer's t-zone showed no change in pore appearance.

extraits.texte: This product actually made my skin drier. I did not have a problem with forehead dryness until I tried Cosrx.

I'm always experimenting with my skin care regimen bc many products irritate my skin and exacerbate my eczema and cause flakes ups or fail to help flare ups. This fully saved me. The pictures of my forehead are 2 weeks apart

I haven't tried a hyaluronic acids serum before, and I was given a bottle to try for survey participation. I mostly use Cosrx products in my daily skincare regimen, items from the snail and cica collections. I have to say, this serum is amazing. I have sensitive, combination skin that's also prone to redness (fitzpatrick skin type 2.) Using it twice a day with the rest of my regular regimen has almost eradicated any redness, smoothed my skin texture, and seems to have balanced my oily and dry zones (hormonal breakouts notwithstanding.) If you haven't tried a hyaluronic acid serum yet, DEFINITELY try this one. My stupidly sensitive skin is totally happy with it and looks even better for it. 10/10 have already recommended it to everyone I know!

Absolutely love this product. I was previously using the "Hydrium Triple Hyaluronic Moisture Ampoule" and this one has a nice serum-y consistency and feels so great on my skin. It's like the hydrium version but slight thicker and amped up. I have very allergic skin, prone to eczema and contact dermatitis, and this product creates a lovely barrier to keep my skin calm, moisturized, and plump. I've already seen my skin be less red since the barrier is more protected. I use this along with the snail mucin essence, and the ceramide gel cream -- great combo!!

I really wanted to love this product. I have about 12 Cosrx products in my daily routine. My skin is extremely dry and never feels quite hydrated. This product was just ok. I didn't feel much different from some of the other Cosrx products I use. The Cosrx rice moisturizer is still my #1.

I really like this serum it is not oily at all. It sinks into the skin easily and fast. The consistency is very light and not sticky. I realized it really has helped with my oil production. I do wish the bottle was a little less opaque so that I can see how much serum I have left.
The product is really very good, but in my experience using this brand I cannot combine it with other brands since I get pimples on my face.
